expansion.unit: one row group x resolved semantic variant x outcome profile outcome
expansion.profileResolution: Resolve binding and requested modes independently of outcome profile. Exact overrides supply fixedModes plus reason where appropriate; no profile silently erases mode identity. Guards/failure invariants are dependencies, never product-success evidence.
expansion.operationBinding: operationRegistry[operation] must list exact schema discriminator or explicit internal invariant entry
expansion.capabilityBinding: operationRegistry[operation].variants[semanticVariant] must reference request/field/mode or local-only contract
expansion.modeExpansion: Resolve semanticVariant through modeExpansionRules before outcome expansion. Resolved variant IDs include __direct/__suggest/__suggestRefused where specified. No runtime fixture may invent or erase a mode case.
expansion.perObligationState: deliveryOverrides[expandedKey] records evidence/status ONLY, never permission to expose a writer. Earliest slice is max(group.slice, mode earliestSlice). Baseline delivery does not mark this future manifest passed.
expansion.publicCoverage: Each exposed registry operation/resolved variant/mode must join ALL matching ledger bases, ALL their required outcome siblings and ALL dependencyRules obligations. Empty/missing/mismatched joins fail. Guards, failureInvariant, local invariants and blocked modes cannot independently authorize supported-product exposure. Direct and suggest exposure are separate keys.
expansion.duplicates: Repeated outline tags allowed; duplicate expanded key or exampleId forbidden.
expansion.enabledRule: Before exposing a variant, compute its complete required sibling+dependency closure, regardless of evidence state. Every key in that closure needs a passed current-run case, exact actual driver/requestedMode, independent fixture and non-planned delivery evidence. Success alone cannot enable it; missing lostReply/finalAuthGate or validation/invariant evidence fails. Outcome records cannot set enabled=true. variantExposure is initially empty; dependency closures do not silently expose dependencies.
expansion.finalRule: All N/R/P entries must be delivered; planned engineering gaps block whole-program completion. B/X require refusal/routing evidence, never close N.
expansion.externalRule: External gates require distinct signed/attributed evidence references, not Cucumber pass substitution. External-only rows have no product operation and are exempt from wire joins only for this reason.

C034/setResetConflict.reason: Overlapping set/reset is invalid in either supported edit mode; each acceptedControl uses disjoint fields in the SAME mode.

C037/partialBorderUnknownRefusal.reason: Cannot materialize complete border from missing effective evidence. Control supplies all border fields in the same mode.

C076/staleTree.reason: Preflight subtree witness drift; unchanged tree control is EDIT. SUGGEST tab deletion is separately blocked, never a control.

C082/suggestDocumentFormatRefusal.reason: documentFormat is unavailable in SUGGEST; pages/pageless variants prove direct support separately.

C108/staleNoFallback.reason: Known stale anchored range before dispatch: reject with zero native or Drive mutations; current range is the permitted direct control. Provider-side CAS rejection is separately covered by exactRange/staleRevision.

C108/deniedNoFallback.reason: Native insertComment is dispatched once and explicitly denied (403); record rejected, never not_sent, and never fall back to Drive unanchored comments. No zero-dispatch claim. Permitted control gets ALL_SAVED and exact anchored readback.

C117/noFallback.reason: Each requested mode receives an explicit provider rejection; no substitution to another mode. Each permittedControl uses exactly that requested mode.

C119/noSubstitution.reason: Denied requested suggestion decision cannot be replaced by a different decision; separately permitted same-action control.

C127/missingKey.reason: Missing required placeholder binding rejects before dispatch; complete bindings accepted under same mode.

C127/unusedKey.reason: Unused supplied binding rejects before dispatch; exactly used keys accepted under same mode.

C135/importFormatsDenied.reason: Read about.importFormats does not advertise conversion; reject before files.create. Control advertises the exact source/result MIME pair; no Docs suggest mode on this route.

C150/sidecarTamper.reason: Bound sidecar digest/provenance mismatch; authentic sidecar control under same edit mode.

C150/noForce.reason: Explicit unsupported force bypass flag rejected; normally guarded push control uses same mode.

C150/noQuiet.reason: Explicit unsupported quiet approval bypass rejected; policy-respecting control uses same mode.

C069/ambiguousLabel.reason: Unqualified duplicate label is ambiguous; exact ID/path control targets one of the actual duplicate labels in the same mode.

C101/ambiguousNameSelector.reason: Only ambiguous name-only selection is refused. Control selects an exact ID among actual duplicate names; never a unique-name stand-in. Lifecycle requests are EDIT-only.

validationModeContract.rule: For every legacy guard/noOp override without fixedModes, derive modes from the operation's declared mode policy BEFORE applying the override profile. Eligible expands guard/noOp independently for direct and suggest; edit-only validation/noOp uses direct only, with reason that supported-input control is EDIT and suggest capability exclusion is covered by positive sibling variants. Collaboration guards are direct; file/Sheets guards are route. No implicit missing native policy is allowed.
validationModeContract.acceptedControl: Legal input accepted by the real public planner in the exact requested mode, not another-mode refusal. Acceptance is not a product-success pass. Invalid fixtures assert zero dispatch only for guard; failureInvariant records actual attempted/rejected submission facts.
validationModeContract.caseMode: Every case/fixture/result includes requestedMode; equality with expanded requestedMode is mandatory, including fixed-mode controls.

outcomeDefaultNonApplicability.guardRejected: Only guard profile uses exact preflight-invalid outcome.
outcomeDefaultNonApplicability.acceptedControl: Only guard profile needs a control proving validation is not unconditional refusal.
outcomeDefaultNonApplicability.expectedFailure: Only failureInvariant has explicit submitted-failure evidence.
outcomeDefaultNonApplicability.permittedControl: Only failureInvariant has the same-action/mode permitted dispatch control.
outcomeDefaultNonApplicability.submissionFacts: Only failureInvariant uses this separately named fact assertion; native/noCas profiles assert facts in their failure outcomes.
outcomeDefaultNonApplicability.noFallback: Only failureInvariant uses this separately named no-substitution assertion; guards assert zero dispatch.

notApplicable.success: Not a product-success variant; permittedControl is necessary but cannot satisfy a sibling supported feature.
notApplicable.invalid: Fixture is an explicitly denied provider request, not schema invalidity.
notApplicable.staleRevision: Underlying native operation owns CAS cases.
notApplicable.comparisonStale: Underlying no-CAS operation owns comparison cases.
notApplicable.lostReply: This variant is explicit rejection; underlying operation owns unknown outcomes.
notApplicable.readbackDenied: Underlying operation owns post-acknowledgement readback denial.
notApplicable.finalAuthGate: Required through underlying product siblings and shared dependencies.
notApplicable.refused: This is a requested operation denied by provider, not a missing feature.
notApplicable.noMutation: Do not infer zero dispatch from provider rejection; submissionFacts records the attempt.

notApplicable.success: Positive operation success belongs to its separate supported semantic variants; acceptedControl proves this guard is not an unconditional refusal.
notApplicable.invalid: guardRejected is the exact invalid fixture.
notApplicable.preservation: noMutation asserts unchanged provider state and zero dispatch for preflight validation.
notApplicable.bounds: Only declared bound guards have bound-specific fixtures.
notApplicable.wrongSubject: Authority checked in the underlying operation profile.
notApplicable.restart: No in-flight stage; key behavior tested separately.
notApplicable.counterexample: acceptedControl is the counterexample to unconditional refusal.
notApplicable.refused: guardRejected distinguishes safety validation from provider-blocked capability.

notApplicable.invalid: Input validation belongs to the underlying operation profile.
notApplicable.staleRevision: No native write; stale comparison may reclassify the plan, never dispatch automatically.
notApplicable.counterexample: Changed-input fixtures are covered by underlying operation.
notApplicable.acceptedControl: Positive writes tested in sibling variants.

notApplicable.staleRevision: No write CAS; snapshot/version drift belongs in semantic variants.
notApplicable.readbackDenied: Read denial is invalid outcome, not post-write verification.
notApplicable.restart: Only durable artifacts/recovery use artifact or invariant profile.
notApplicable.noMutation: Every read case additionally asserts zero provider mutations.

notApplicable.counterexample: Invalid and preservation cases provide counterexamples.
notApplicable.refused: N implementation cannot close with refusal.
notApplicable.noMutation: Zero writes asserted in invalid/approval-denial/stale-preflight cases.

notApplicable.staleRevision: Provider has no required revision for this route; do not invent CAS.
notApplicable.noMutation: Assert zero on preflight failures, not after comparison race.

notApplicable.staleRevision: Read/export artifact is not provider mutation.
notApplicable.comparisonStale: Frozen source provenance, not overwrite comparison.
notApplicable.approval: Local artifact generation uses authorized read, no provider write approval.
notApplicable.lostReply: Local receipt/idempotence is restart semantic variant, not provider lost-write claim.
notApplicable.readbackDenied: Provider read failure is invalid; artifact digest is checked independently.
notApplicable.noMutation: All cases assert zero Google mutations.

notApplicable.success: No native implementation promised for this precisely named B/X variant.
notApplicable.invalid: Refusal cases validate exact capability classification.
notApplicable.bounds: Schema bounds are covered in tool-family validation.
notApplicable.wrongSubject: No account information disclosed on capability-only refusal.

notApplicable.success: Destination capability has its own success obligations.
notApplicable.preservation: Route does not mutate by itself.
notApplicable.bounds: Input validation delegated and checked by invalid case.
notApplicable.approval: Must preserve destination policy, proven by routed case and destination tests.

notApplicable.preservation: Invariant cases must assert relevant preservation directly.
notApplicable.bounds: Only bound invariants require bound variants.
notApplicable.wrongSubject: Only identity invariants require subject variants.
notApplicable.staleRevision: Specific CAS variants enumerated where applicable.
notApplicable.comparisonStale: Specific no-CAS variants enumerated where applicable.
notApplicable.approval: Specific approval variants enumerated where applicable.
notApplicable.lostReply: Specific loss variants enumerated where applicable.
notApplicable.readbackDenied: Specific readback variants enumerated where applicable.
notApplicable.restart: Reopen variants enumerated explicitly for claims/receipts.
notApplicable.refused: Invariant is behavior, not blocked product capability.
notApplicable.noMutation: Assertions determined by each named boundary, not blanket zero.

modeExpansionRules.appliesTo: Resolve modes from BASE native/noCas operation bindings independently of outcome overrides. Missing policy fails, never defaults. Explicit fixedModes require reasons. Other base profiles use nonWriterModes. Append __{requestedMode} to every variant, including guards/invariants; unsupported suggest uses __suggestRefused and blocked/B. requestedMode remains suggest, not suggestRefused.

eligible-fragment-request-intersection.note: All listed wire requests in these bindings are suggest-eligible. A later added edit-only fragment request must add an explicit variant override before enablement, not decide from simulator output.

algorithm-contract-required.note: N preserving algorithms remain planned until successful independent contracts exist; a refusal never enables these variants.

edit-only.validationReason: Legal same-mode acceptedControl exists only in EDIT. Positive siblings independently require suggest exclusion; refusal never proves suggest validation/support.

K7.mode-specific.note: noFallback has explicit fixedModes; unknown variants fail.

collaboration-C.note: Direct collaboration with mandatory review, not suggest authoring.

creation-then-C.note: Creation then direct native population; no suggest creation.

drive-no-cas.note: No Docs editMode on this route.

sheets-no-cas.note: Sheets data modes remain semantic variants, not Docs editMode.

dependencyRules.closure: Exposure of operation/resolvedSemanticVariant requires all matching ledger joins/outcomes, all same-operation validation/failure/noOp obligations in the SAME requestedMode, and family/common dependencies below. Dependency row selectors mean ALL expanded outcomes of all invariant-profile groups in those rows, not one convenient case. Additional selected operations are explicit. No unrelated one-case join; no future obligation is passed merely by dependency selection.

crossOperationValidations.reason: Every style command exposes set/reset, even when its primary binding is text/paragraph/page rather than reset.

families.note: Codec-dependent C025 Markdown/HTML invariants only for markdownRich/workingCopyPush; other content requires text/inline/blocks variants, not future codecs.
C043 table-dependent variants only for preserveCustom.tableContained; ordinary lists require listTabsThenHeading/nonBmp.
Image variants additionally require every C092 asset invariant; chip/dropdown do not acquire irrelevant image dependencies.
C156/C158 are required for word only, not Markdown/plain blob writers.

dependencyRules.modeDependencies: Any semantic writer exposed in suggest or commentProposal mode additionally requires all C115/C118/C120/C121 invariants. Local invariants are shared engine contracts and cannot be counted as direct/suggest product success.
dependencyRules.nonWriterExposure: For public read/artifact/control operations require all own siblings and same-operation invariants/validation. Snapshot readers additionally require C009 invariants. Lifecycle control tools additionally require C027/C190/C191/C200/C203 invariants. Public lifecycle/recovery controls bound to invariant-profile groups have kind control and must meet their full sibling/dependency closure; internal-only invariants have no public exposure. A new writer with no matching family is an audit error.

wireSchemaContract.rule: For EVERY declared Docs wire request and every independent request fixture, resolve Request union -> request schema -> property $ref -> nested properties/array items. Unknown path, wrong value type/enum/unit, output-only property/value or invalid mask fails before evidence can count. A request name alone is insufficient. Actual fixture masks/reset omissions must match declared effects. Dynamic reset paths and named-style masks are validated at fixture/runtime audit, never exempted because static binding lacks fieldsByVariant.
wireSchemaContract.maskRule: Paths are relative to the request's implicit style/properties root; no root prefix or wildcard. Validate every mask segment after explicit documented snake_case aliases. Whole structured value mask is permitted only with valid writable supplied leaves. Omitted field is reset only when schema/request permits reset; complete paragraph borders require whole-border mask and all components.
wireSchemaContract.writabilityRule: Discovery readOnly flags and property/enumDescriptions stating Output only/read-only are denial evidence. Supplement schema with reviewed request-specific allow/reset/mask constraints; never infer writability merely from property existence. Unknown writable status blocks enablement, not all document reading.

pageSize.type: finite positive number magnitudes; unit PT only; dimension values within declared product bounds

wireSchemaContract.namedStyleRequired: named_style_type plus each changed parent and nested child; explicit clear-all parent is the only empty-parent reset case

fixtureFactEvidenceRule: These facts must be computed from independent before/expected-request/after fixtures AND compared with the real application result/readback. A self-declared boolean or unique-name control is not evidence. The temporary research validator only checks synthetic contract counterexamples, not real executions.

namedRangeDuplicateContract.createDuplicateName: Start with one range named Shared; create a second range named Shared at another witnessed span; verify two distinct IDs, both names Shared and original range unchanged. N direct success is mandatory; createNamedRange in suggest is blocked.
namedRangeDuplicateContract.exactIdAmongDuplicates: Use one ID among at least two ranges sharing the name, remove only that label and preserve its text plus the other label.
namedRangeDuplicateContract.explicitAllDuplicates: Explicit expectedCount=2 selects two ranges with the same name, deletes both labels, preserves all text; count drift refuses.
namedRangeDuplicateContract.ambiguousNameSelector: Unqualified name matching two ranges refuses; accepted control uses one exact ID from the same duplicate-name fixture, not a unique-name substitute.

capabilityRules.idNoCasConditions: K7 exact witnessed action/author/role, mandatory review, selected at planning, no index write fallback
capabilityRules.saveEvidence: K7 operation matrix; unexpected thread effects stop rather than ignore

bindingCatalog.resolution: Exact operationBindings entry overrides prefixBindings. No match fails audit. Prefix internal bindings are not public tool registrations; their scenario must exercise the real named component via a public driver where relevant. Wire write request classes must independently appear in the enabled operation capability registry. Expected schema labels below are planned contract IDs, not existing registrations.

docs_apply.seal.note: Dispatch requests derive exclusively from the sealed child operation bindings; this entry is sealing/claim behavior, not fake successful mutation.

docs_plan_content.replaceAll.note: Resolve bounded exact matches rather than provider-unbounded default all-tabs.

publicDriver.requires: real parser -> semantic planner/compiler -> native adapter -> independent verifier; no codec-only success

docs_plan_style.reset.fields: Explicit reset field list from variant fixture; wildcard forbidden.

docs_plan_list.preserveCustom.note: Request set is an allowed compiler vocabulary, not proof custom preservation is solved. Each N variant needs independent successful fixtures before enablement.

docs_plan_media.reinsertImage.note: New identity, not replaceImage alternative enum.
